dialogs.about: 할아버지와 오래된 나무 상자를 열어 봐요

lines.en: Look at this old box. Does it belong to you?
lines.ko: 이 낡은 상자 좀 보세요. 할아버지 거예요?

lines.en: Yes, it is mine. It contains old letters.
lines.ko: 네, 제 거예요. 안에 옛날 편지가 들어 있어요.

lines.en: Do any photos remain in it?
A few. I suppose the others are gone.
lines.ko: 몇 장요. 나머지는 없어진 것 같아요.

lines.en: My garden photo disappeared years ago.
lines.ko: 우리 정원 사진은 몇 해 전에 없어졌어요.

lines.en: Wait! Here it is, under the letters.
Wow, thank you! Does it matter where I keep it?
It depends on you. The box is safe.
Then I will work on the album again tomorrow.
Good. Nothing will disappear again.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 이제 아무것도 사라지지 않을 거예요.

lines.en: Hello. Does this bottle contain sugar?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이 병에 설탕이 들어 있나요?

lines.en: Hello! No, it contains only fruit and water.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 아니요, 과일과 물만 들어 있어요.

lines.en: Good. Does the time of day matter?
It depends on your meals. Take it after breakfast.
I took a different one last month.
I see. How did you feel then?
Fine, thank you. But I get tired by evening.
I suppose you need more rest. Walking helps.
lines.ko: 좀 더 쉬셔야 할 것 같아요. 걷기도 도움이 돼요.

lines.en: Should I continue taking this?
Yes. While some remains, it will still help you.
lines.ko: 네. 남아 있는 동안은 계속 도움이 될 거예요.
